title: Submit exchange application
description: Prepare and submit the 2026 university exchange application.

documents.source_text: Exchange application requirements and submission guidance.

tasks.title: Confirm eligibility
tasks.description: Check exchange eligibility requirements with the international office.
tasks.consequence_if_missed: The application may be rejected as ineligible.

tasks.title: Request official transcript
tasks.description: Request an official transcript from the student records office.
tasks.consequence_if_missed: The application cannot include the required transcript.

tasks.title: Ask lecturer for reference
tasks.description: Ask a lecturer to provide an academic reference letter.

dependencies.reason: The lecturer needs the confirmed exchange details.

tasks.consequence_if_missed: The application will be missing an academic reference.

tasks.title: Prepare personal statement
tasks.description: Draft and revise the personal statement for the exchange application.
tasks.consequence_if_missed: The final application will be incomplete.

tasks.title: Upload transcript and reference
tasks.description: Upload the official transcript and signed reference letter.

dependencies.reason: The transcript must be received first.
The reference must be received first.

tasks.consequence_if_missed: Supporting documents will be absent at submission.

tasks.title: Review and submit application
tasks.description: Complete a final review and submit the exchange application.

dependencies.reason: All supporting documents must be uploaded.
The personal statement must be complete.

tasks.consequence_if_missed: The exchange application will not be considered.
